verdict.rationale: Zep documents official Python SDK usage extensively (pip install zep-cloud, three-line integration, thread.add_messages, graph.edge.delete) plus a CLI (zepctl) and framework integrations (LangGraph, CrewAI, Google ADK, AutoGen, etc.), indicating a mature multi-language SDK ecosystem. missing for 10: explicit list of all supported languages (e.g. TypeScript/Go SDKs) and independent developer testimonials confirming SDK quality beyond vendor docs.
